hero.description:
I'm a backend and AI engineer working in the .NET ecosystem. After 5+ years of QA on software for global tech clients like Netflix, Apple, and AWS, I build systems that catch problems before they ship: secure by design and production-ready.
My capstone, EKOMART, is a live N-Tier e-commerce platform with an AI review-moderation pipeline.

about.title: Engineering Perspective
about.p1: My experience in localization and quality assurance for flagship products of prestigious brands has consistently reinforced a critical lesson: A single bug or process vulnerability can impact millions of users and severely damage brand reputation.
about.p2: Today I apply that same meticulous precision much earlier in the process: instead of finding defects after release, I focus on preventing them at design time. I write clean, maintainable, secure-by-design code. I do not merely write syntax; I engineer robust systems that prioritize scalability and reliability.
about.p3: I recently completed a 320-hour, full-time backend engineering program run with the Istanbul Chamber of Commerce, building 11 progressively complex ASP.NET Core applications. Alongside Harvard's CS50 and an ongoing B.Sc. in Management Information Systems at Istanbul University, this consolidates my computer science foundations and lets me architect enterprise-grade solutions using C# and .NET.
about.p4: My Goal: To bring my multidimensional perspective on quality, security, and architecture to a forward-thinking engineering team building backend and AI systems.
about.focus_backend: Backend & Architecture: Designing scalable systems using N-Tier architecture, the Repository/Unit of Work pattern, and SOLID principles, with a dual EF Core/Dapper data layer across C# and .NET.
about.focus_security: Data & Security: Ensuring data integrity with MSSQL, PostgreSQL, and Entity Framework Core; implementing ASP.NET Identity, JWT, and Google OAuth while proactively mitigating CSRF/XSS vulnerabilities through OWASP Secure Coding principles. Application security and threat modeling are my focus areas, with an emphasis on catching risk at design time.
about.focus_ai: AI Integration: Building LLM-backed features that can be tested and measured: an AI review-moderation pipeline running in production on EKOMART and, as my current focus, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assistant over Turkish legislation.
about.focus_quality: Process & Quality: As a Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt certified developer, I execute process-driven development aimed at reducing technical debt and achieving operational excellence.

projects.title: Projects
projects.p1_desc: A full N-Tier e-commerce platform (Entities → Data → Business → Api/Web) with a dual EF Core/Dapper data layer behind a shared Repository/Unit of Work abstraction. Features ASP.NET Identity, Google OAuth, and JWT across separate MVC and API surfaces, atomic transaction-safe checkout with real-time stock re-validation, PDF/Excel/QR generation, and an AI-powered review moderation pipeline (translation and toxicity classification via the Hugging Face Inference API). Deployed to production on Azure App Service with a Cloudflare-proxied custom domain and GitHub Actions CI/CD.
projects.p2_desc: An enterprise-grade Content Management System developed in an N-Tier architecture using C# and .NET, featuring Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and secure file management. Defensive programming practices are applied project-wide, with mitigations for common vulnerabilities such as CSRF, XSS, and mass assignment.
projects.p3_desc: A decoupled API/MVC venue-booking system built with Dapper and T-SQL stored procedures for high-performance data access. Applies the Repository pattern and DTOs end-to-end, with sliding-window rate limiting to protect the API from abuse.

contact.title: What's Next?
contact.text: I'm open to backend (.NET), AI-integration, and solutions engineering roles, with a particular interest in teams where security matters. If you're building systems that need to be reliable, measurable, and hard to break, I'd love to talk.
